Lazy backfill on retrieve/ingest or explicit script only. Files: crowley.py, app.py, docs.

CROWLEY_EMBED_PROVIDER=off skips embedding load; health reports degraded mode clearly
Missing sqlite-vec never raises during setup
Existing tests/test_retrieval_explanation.py passes
Optional scripts/backfill_embeddings.py or documented manual backfill path
